infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MahekOne lets you attach a bill or a receipt you already photographed to an expense claim. It only sees the photo you pick.

plugins.microphonePermission: MahekOne lets you speak a note instead of typing it — what you say is written out in English for you to read and correct before it is saved. It is used for nothing else, and every box it appears on can still be typed into.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: MahekOne records where a visit, an order or a payment was taken, and follows your route only while your day is open. It stops when you punch out.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: MahekOne follows your route while your day is open, including with the screen off — a call between two shops should not leave a gap in the map. It stops the moment you punch out.

plugins.cameraPermission: MahekOne takes a photo of you each time you punch in or out, so the office can see the day was yours, and photographs what a visit needs: the shop, a cheque, a bill, a sample, your vehicle's meter. Nothing is taken without you pressing the button.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Unlock MBOS with Face ID instead of typing a password.
